title: You Are the Christ

scenes.title: Who Do You Say I Am?

bsb: When Jesus came to the region of Caesarea Philippi, He questioned His disciples:
kjv: When Jesus came into the coasts of Cesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying,

bsb: Who do people say the Son of Man is?
kjv: Whom do men say that I the Son of man am?

bsb: Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah; and still others, Jeremiah or one of the prophets.
kjv: Some say that thou art John the Baptist: some, Elias; and others, Jeremias, or one of the prophets.

bsb: Who do you say I am?
kjv: But whom say ye that I am?

bsb: You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.
kjv: Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.

bsb: Blessed are you, Simon son of Jonah! For this was not revealed to you by flesh and blood, but by My Father in heaven.
kjv: for flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Father which is in heaven.

bsb: Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah
kjv: Some say that thou art John the Baptist: some, Elias

bsb: Who do you say I am?
kjv: But whom say ye that I am?

bsb: You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.
kjv: Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.

puzzles.prompt: Tap Caesarea Philippi, far in the north near Mount Hermon.
puzzles.hint: It's the farthest north of all, above the Sea of Galilee.

bsb: You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.
kjv: Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.

reflect: Jesus asks each of us the same question He asked Peter: “Who do you say I am?”
discuss: People had many ideas about who Jesus was. What do people say about Jesus today?
How would you answer Jesus' question, “Who do you say I am?”
Jesus said Peter learned this from the Father in heaven. How does God help us know who Jesus is?
prayer: Father in heaven, help us know that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of the living God, and say so with Peter. Amen.
